_doc: Named parts of a 2D painting a cue can point at (GameEngine._painting_spot, 2026-11-08). Key: the bg src as resolve_bg gives it. Each spot: [u, v] or [u, v, zoom], u/v the spot's place on the picture from the top left (0..1); zoom defaults to 1.5. Place a spot by reading the picture on a grid; name it for the word the line uses.
